title: Anuradhapura
description: Ancient capital of great stupas and the revered Sri Maha Bodhi tree. Our travellers experienced peaceful evening meditation beneath the sacred Bodhi canopy.

title: Sigiriya Citadel
description: Marvel of 5th-century royal architecture and landscaped water gardens. Private dawn ascent guided by our expert Ceylon cultural historian.

title: Ella Tea Country
description: Misty emerald peaks and hands-on artisanal tea plucking. Bespoke journeys through historic colonial tea trails and cascading highland waterfalls.

title: Mirissa Sanctuary
description: Gentle ocean giants and pristine golden coastlines. Private catamaran sunrise voyage encountering blue whales in the deep southern waters of Ceylon.

title: Kandy Royal Kingdom
description: The revered Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic amidst scenic mountains. Exclusive access to the evening royal ceremony with authentic blessings.
